label: Smoothability of Calabi–Yau threefolds

abstract_html: We determine the analytic deformation space of a projective Calabi–Yau threefold with ordinary double points and anticanonical cones over smooth del Pezzo surfaces of degrees five and six, admitting a smooth projective crepant resolution small at the nodes and given by the vertex blow-up at the cones. Up to a smooth factor, its semiuniversal base is the scheme-theoretic intersection of the product of the marked local bases with the space of homological relations on the resolution. Link periods identify the strata on which prescribed singularities persist. We construct two projective examples with the same smooth reduced germ and the same tangent dimension. The nilradical has square zero in one and nonzero square in the other. The proof establishes compatibility of link periods with Artin base change and detects global obstructions to lifting by localization and pairing with Cartier divisor classes.
